evidence: All five dimension prompts and their injected app_context/criteria describe Kittle & Rowe matter chat only. (1) Product/deliverable: every prompt targets http://localhost:3000 (render/constraints/functional/polish/visual prompt.md line 1), matching integration.md:3 port 3000; render criterion (gates/render/judge.toml:27) names 'a real Kittle & Rowe matter chat'; app_context.md:3 'Kittle & Rowe matter chat'. (2) Credentials: the only accounts anywhere in tests/ are harriet/dev/sian/gwen/paul@kittle.test (grep: 26/14/14/38/6 hits), all with password123, matching walls-and-retention.md:3-11, seed_data.json accounts and app_context.md:8-16 (roles, Dev walled from M-12, Gwen M-11/M-13, Paul M-12 all match seed). No @docketlight.test/@northstar.test or other sibling accounts; grep for chambers/colderwater/hireops/candidate/ticket/invoice/patient/example.com/TODO found only the visual criterion id 'phone_chambers'. (3) Entities: only matter ids M-11/M-12/M-13 appear (46/28/42 hits); every quoted seed fact re-derived against seed_data.json: titles 'Pryce lease dispute', 'Pryce will', 'Marsh Holdings acquisition'; K-1 sent 1 May with K-14 reply and held K-15; Boundary note at 2026-05-05T11:00:00Z exactly 7 days before the clock and 'Rent review meeting' one second later; Insurer letter K-17 held, 3 May, M-11 7-day; Probate 4,200 with 2,400 version and held executor message 4 May in 30-day M-13 (8 days 2 h old, so 'eight-day-old' is correct); 'Draft heads of terms ready for comment.' and 'Fenwick' in M-12; 'Draft will sent for your review.' in M-13; 'Pasted from the lease: Schedule 2...' in M-11; 'Survey booked for Friday.' in M-11; held edited 'Landlord's notice received and filed.' with version 'Landlords notice recieved.'. Transcript heading time 2026-05-12 11:00 matches the fixed clock (integration.md:7). (4) Screens: app_context Key screens (sign-in, matter list with unread counts, thread with reply/edit/delete/copy-link/hold, timer and wall controls, mentions list, search, transcript) match the brief and notes and are exactly the surfaces criteria use. (5) Cross-prompt/state consistency: the functional run restores the state later prompts rely on (M-13 timer back to 30 days at timer_changes step 4; Sian's M-13 wall lifted in wall_added_live step 4; Sian's M-11 wall and M-12 timer restored at the end of persistence), so polish hold_mark (executor message On hold in M-13), timer_label (M-11), and visual retention_marks/transcript_page/phone criteria reference objects that still exist; polish/visual 'Task state' sections name the functional run's writes accurately. Functional prompt 'Each session grades one criterion' and 'The persistence criterion is last' match judge.toml mode='individual' and the 16-criterion list ending in persistence; restart_app matches restart_mcp.py:14 and the $APP_RESTART_HELPER export in test.sh:193; the comment's 16 x 550 + 900 + 900 = 10600 matches the 11100 s scored budget in test.sh:224. Generic gate phrases ('empty workspace', 'static shell') are template boilerplate, not sibling residue. Weak-app/alternative probe: a sibling-clone app (e.g. a generic chat with channels) would fail the render gate's Kittle & Rowe/sign-in-with-gwen requirement and every seed-quoted criterion; a conforming Kittle app using different labels (e.g. '7d' timer, 'Held' badge wording) is not misdescribed by the prompts, which judge observable outcomes. Instances reported (non-defects): visual criterion id/name 'phone_chambers' (scored/visual/judge.toml:69-70) uses barristers' 'chambers' wording for a solicitors' firm client phone view; it is an internal label, its description correctly says 'Gwen's matter thread at 390 by 844', and no sibling task uses the word, so it is not residue. Polish id 'transcript_print' does not ask for print styling; its description grades on-screen document reading only. Frozen-input check: manifest.json input hashes re-verified (66 files, 0 mismatches); frozen app_context.md and functional judge.toml/prompt.md bytes equal projects/kittle-matter-chat. This row is a static text audit; no judge run was needed or claimed.
